description: An object of this type describes a category of jobs.

attributes.name: str
description: String holding all elements of a category (requests, user, project, ...).

attributes.name: refcount
description: Number of jobs referencing this category.

attributes.name: rejected
description: Has this category been rejected as it can not be dispatched now?

attributes.name: cache
description: Stores all info, which cannot run this job category.

attributes.name: messages_added
description: If true, the scheduler info messages have been added for this category.

attributes.name: resource_contribution
description: Resource request dependent contribution on urgency.
This value is common for all jobs of a category.

attributes.name: rc_valid
description: Indicates whether the cached CT_resource_contribution is valid.

attributes.name: reservation_rejected
description: Has this category been rejected as it can not be reserved?
